name.en-US: The Upper Room: A Drama of Christ’s Passion
name.pt-BR: O Cenáculo: Drama da Paixão de Cristo

description.en-US: Benson's drama of the Passion (1914), set in the upper room of the Last Supper and in the days around it: a prologue and three acts, with the author's introduction and preface.
description.pt-BR: O drama da Paixão de Benson (1914), ambientado no cenáculo da Úlima Ceia e nos dias em torno dela: um prólogo e três atos, com a introdução e o prefácio do autor.

sources.edition: The Upper Room: A Drama of Christ’s Passion (London: Hutchinson, 1914), Internet Archive full-text OCR (upperroomdramaof00bens).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1914, so the text is public domain.
